mentions.name: Federal prison re-entry program automation
mentions.description: This project automates programs that federal prisons run to support newly released inmates with re-entry, such as inmate account deposits, as shown by an example page for FCI Atlanta.
mentions.problem: Programs that help newly released inmates with re-entry are manual and benefit from automation.
mentions.audience: Newly released inmates transitioning back into society
mentions.source_excerpt:
I have been working on automating many of the programs that federal prisons run to help newly released inmates with re-entry.

Example: https://atlanta-fci.bop.doj.dev/program/65545-inmate-account-deposits
mentions.author: arionhardison
